label: Peshawar — KP Provincial Capital
sub: Seat of PTI-led Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government; center of political standoff with Islamabad

label: Islamabad — Federal Capital
sub: Federal government considering emergency rule; site of PTI long march destination

label: Gandi Chowk, Lakki Marwat — march start
sub: PTI long march set off here on Oct 4 under CM Sohail Afridi after talks collapsed.

label: Karak — first overnight camp
sub: The convoy camped at Karak on the night of Oct 4.

label: Yarik toll plaza — blocked by containers
sub: Containers blocked the plaza, so ex-CM Ali Amin Gandapur turned back on Oct 4. Coordinates approximate.

label: Khairabad — planned announcement point
sub: Afridi said he would announce the next step when the convoy reached Khairabad on Oct 8. Coordinates approximate.

label: Governor's House, Peshawar
sub: Interior Minister Naqvi chaired the Apex Committee here on Oct 12 after emergency was imposed. Coordinates approximate.

label: Swabi — internet disruption
sub: Internet services reported disrupted in Swabi and Peshawar after emergency imposition.

label: Attock Bridge — approach to Islamabad
sub: Reported blocked in late September, prompting PTI to delay its march. Coordinates approximate.
